ellmer tools for kuzco computer vision functions

Source: R/tools.R
kuzco-tools.Rd

Lite-weight wrappers that expose each kuzco computer vision function as an ellmer::tool() so they can be registered on a chatbot, e.g.

chat <- ellmer::chat_ollama(model = "qwen2.5vl")
chat$register_tool(tool_llm_image_classification())
chat$chat("What is in this image?", ellmer::content_image_file("img/photo.jpg"))

Each constructor fixes the model and provider at registration time and exposes only the arguments an LLM should control (image, additional_prompt, language, plus function-specific ones). The tools always use the "ellmer" backend, which enforces structured outputs. Results (single-row data frames) are collapsed to compact JSON text so the model gets a clean, readable result.

Usage

tool_llm_image_alt_text(
  llm_model = "qwen2.5vl",
  provider = "ollama",
  name = "kuzco_image_alt_text"
)

tool_llm_image_classification(
  llm_model = "qwen2.5vl",
  provider = "ollama",
  name = "kuzco_image_classification"
)

tool_llm_image_custom(
  llm_model = "qwen2.5vl",
  provider = "ollama",
  name = "kuzco_image_custom"
)

tool_llm_image_extract_text(
  llm_model = "qwen2.5vl",
  provider = "ollama",
  name = "kuzco_image_extract_text"
)

tool_llm_image_recognition(
  llm_model = "qwen2.5vl",
  provider = "ollama",
  name = "kuzco_image_recognition"
)

tool_llm_image_sentiment(
  llm_model = "qwen2.5vl",
  provider = "ollama",
  name = "kuzco_image_sentiment"
)

Arguments

llm_model

a local LLM model either pulled from ollama or hosted

provider

for backend = "ellmer", provider refers to the ellmer::chat_* providers, e.g. "ollama", "openai", "claude"

name

tool name registered with the chatbot; defaults are "kuzco_image_<task>"

Functions

  • tool_llm_image_alt_text(): Tool: generate alt text for an image

  • tool_llm_image_classification(): Tool: classify an image

  • tool_llm_image_custom(): Tool: run a custom image prompt

  • tool_llm_image_extract_text(): Tool: extract text from an image (OCR)

  • tool_llm_image_recognition(): Tool: recognize objects in an image

  • tool_llm_image_sentiment(): Tool: analyze image sentiment
